name.zh: 猛犸象（真猛犸象启发成年形态）

description.en: Woolly mammoth-inspired static reconstruction with four supported feet, small ears and recurved tusks. The origin follows the documented mean of four sole centres, not the footprint bounding box; coat clumps, colour and individual proportions are artistic.
description.zh: 猛犸象启发的静态复原，四足承地、小耳与回曲獠牙。原点采用记录的四个足底中心均值，而非足迹外接框；块状毛束、颜色和个体比例为艺术表达。

author: Leon Made This / s010s
origin: Average of four actual sole fan center vertices on ground plane; identity root
